card.name: Punctuation inside vaccine and serogroup lists
card.fires_on: Punctuation (comma, slash or open parenthesis) right after a vaccine or bacterial name such as serogroup A, Mumps, Hib or meningococcal vaccines, where a list or abbreviation follows.

modes.label: Comma after serogroup A
modes.description: The comma after 'A' in a list of meningococcal serogroups.
modes.example: (serogroups A<<,>> C, W, Y and B)

modes.label: Parenthesis after vaccine or bacteria name
modes.description: An opening bracket after a vaccine or organism name that introduces an abbreviation or the serogroups.

modes.label: Slash in combined vaccine
modes.description: The slash joining vaccine names in a combination vaccine.

card.writes: No clear link to the promoted tokens; the suppressed tokens are number words like thirty and twenty.
card.plain: It fires on the comma, slash or bracket inside vaccine lists, such as meningococcal serogroups A, C, W, Y and B.
